source.stem:
The engine of a motor vehicle develops a large amount of power.
Which statement is correct?

options.text: The driving force acting on the vehicle must be large.
The engine must have a very large volume.
The engine must transfer large amounts of energy each second.
The vehicle must be very fast.

intelligence.enrichment: In a plane mirror image, the left side appears as the right side and the right side appears as the left side; this perceived left-right reversal is lateral inversion. Because of lateral inversion, actions or writing facing a plane mirror appear reversed left-to-right in the mirror image. The learner correctly applies this rule: In a plane mirror image, the left side appears as the right side and the right side appears as the left side; this perceived left-right reversal is lateral inversion. A mirror copies left and right exactly as they are.
